data.title: Metaplanet plans to put 2,100 Bitcoin into Super League, renamed Superplanet
data.description: Metaplanet is expected to own 95.7% of Superplanet while its business continues; closing is expected in Q4 2026, subject to stockholder approval.
data.author: Stock Titan
data.keywords: Super League, SLE, Metaplanet, proposed transaction, Bitcoin treasury, cryptocurrency, corporate name change, Nasdaq
